heading: INT. STRANDED BUS ON FLOODED CAUSEWAY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. STRANDED BUS ON FLOODED CAUSEWAY - NIGHT
A mid-size passenger bus, headlights still burning, surrounded by black water that laps at the doors.
The aisle is wet to the ankle.
Rain drums on the roof.
GWEN MARSDEN, fifties, the driver, grips the wheel though the engine is dead.
HIRO YAMAMOTO, forties, a salesman with a leather briefcase, stands in the aisle.
OLUWASEUN, twenties, sits on the back bench with her knees drawn up.
AUNTIE LUPE, seventies, wraps a shawl around a covered basket.
BARNABY, ten, sits very still beside her.
Everybody stay on the seats. Above the water line.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: How far is the next village?
units.name: HIRO

units.text: Two miles.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: In which direction?
units.name: HIRO

units.text: Away from the water.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: Hiro lifts his briefcase to his chest.
He sets it down.
He lifts it again.
Eat something, my darling.
units.name: AUNTIE LUPE

units.text: I'm not hungry.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Eat.
units.name: AUNTIE LUPE

units.text: Barnaby takes a roll from the basket and holds it in both hands without biting it.
Oluwaseun shifts her feet up onto the seat.
Okay. Okay. Okay.
units.name: OLUWASEUN

units.text: Did somebody say something?
units.name: HIRO

units.text: No.
units.name: OLUWASEUN

units.text: The bus tilts a few degrees.
Everyone grabs a seatback.
A cold line of water slides along the floor.
Nobody panic. Everybody move to the front.
units.name: GWEN

units.text: They move.
Hiro hesitates, then offers Auntie Lupe his arm.
She takes it without a word.
Barnaby sets down the roll and picks up the basket.
Leave it, darling.
units.name: AUNTIE LUPE

units.text: It's heavy.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Then we carry it together.
units.name: AUNTIE LUPE
